**NABB** is a national registration code used within the Danish healthcare system to identify patients receiving intensive therapy ("intensiv therapy") [^src1]. In the context of the Acute Surgery Database (AKDB), NABB is one of the specific codes utilized to track and measure quality indicators related to postoperative care [^src1]. Specifically, it is used alongside other codes like NABE (intensive observation) and NABC (intermediate observation) to capture data for [[indikator-6|Indikator 6]], which monitors intermediate admissions [^src1]. 

The data for 2023 relies exclusively on reports where codes such as NABB, NABE, or NABC were applied [^src1]. However, the use of these specific registration codes carries a noted risk of underreporting, prompting strategic recommendations within the AKDB to transition toward standardized SOR codes in the future to improve data accuracy and achieve targets, such as raising the standard for Indikator 6 to 80% [^src1].
